[BSP reconstruction 00736b60]
Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __cdecl void->EAX, plain RET at 00736c2d. Same double-checked lazy 8-byte singleton shape as 00736a90 but over global DAT_010904d4: malloc(8) at 00736bba, base lifetime vtable 00cfea00 at +4, then primary vtable 00cfea20 at +0 and final lifetime vtable 00cfea1c at +4 (00736bc8/00736bcf/00736bd5); object+4 registered through 00bd0c30 under the lifetime lock. Primary vtable 00cfea20 = {007370d0 scalar deleting dtor, 00bb83a0 create}. 00bb83a0 is ECX factory, two stack strings, RET 8 (00bb84b3 and three sibling epilogues): it takes the last five characters of the system path when its length exceeds 4 and compares them to literal '.mpak' at 00ceba84 through 00425850, returning null otherwise. On a match it takes the critical section DAT_010904e0, reads cached provider DAT_010904dc and returns it when set, otherwise allocates 0x44 bytes and constructs through 00bb8240. So this is the MPAK (.mpak) provider factory, distinct from the MPKG (.mpkg) factory 00736a90. Sole caller BSP_Application_Initialize 0073d410 at 0073d955, outside both the DAT_0109ceec and DAT_0109cf00 first-time gates; its result is appended to the provider manager at 0073d95d through 00be0660, making it the fourth startup factory. It is registered after the 0073cb10 package scan, which enumerates only extension 'mpkg', so no .mpak archive is mounted by startup scanning. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_VFS_SINGLETONS.md; reports/app_init_vfs_singletons.json.
